name: DL3DV-benchmark-preprocessed
description: A preprocessed collection of datasets for 3D computer vision tasks, intended to simplify evaluation and training for multi-view/3D tasks (e.g., depth estimation, pose estimation and reconstruction). The dataset provides standardized inputs and splits to enable benchmarking of 3D/vision algorithms. It is mainly targeted at researchers working on multi-view geometry and deep 3D reconstruction pipelines.
evaluation_method: task-dependent: Chamfer distance / rotation & translation error / IoU / EPE depending on task
general_score_metric: Chamfer distance / pose_error (rotation/translation) depending on task
reputation: A practical preprocessed benchmark hosted on Hugging Face, used by researchers needing standardized 3D vision inputs; adoption is modest and task-dependent.
